Instead I try treating the blocks as cells in a coarser grid: grouping rows and columns into bands (like 10-13, 14-17, 18-21 for rows and 7-10, 11-14, 15-18 for columns), then marking which band-pairs contain 2-blocks with 8. That reproduces the training output exactly. Applying similar band logic to the query case just happens to collapse to a plain bounding box since the blocks don't align to consistent band sizes, so the rule seems to be: downscale to block resolution based on the block grouping, defaulting to literal bounding box when groupings are irregular.
